summary: Highway Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that on May 29 and May 30, 2026, directors Marcus Bagnall and Patrick Michaels resigned from the board. The resignations were not due to any disagreement with the company regarding operations, policies, or practices. The board expressed gratitude for their service. As a non-US foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as an equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K for a director departure. The resignations appear orderly and routine rather than abrupt or forced. What to watch: any subsequent disclosures regarding replacement directors or changes in board composition.
